With two outer zippered pockets and two inner pockets, you'll have ample space to keep your essentials close at hand.
The jacket's thoughtful design includes ribbed cuffs and a bottom, ensuring a snug fit that keeps the cold out while maintaining a sleek silhouette. The iconic Parajumpers patch on the sleeve and the vibrant yellow tape closure at the neck add a touch of personality, making this jacket a true conversation starter.
Available in the XL size, the Nero Hoody Bomber Jacket is the perfect addition to your outdoor wardrobe. With four available images showcasing its impeccable design, you're sure to find the perfect jacket to elevate your style and keep you warm and comfortable on your next adventure.
